title: rhAmpSeq Library Prep Part 2 - Cleanup 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples with beads are incubated for 10 minutes
The magnetic module is engaged for 5 minutes
Remainder of ethyl alcohol is removed
Samples are air dried for 3 minutes
Magnetic module is engaged for 3 minutes

steps.title: Add AMPure XP beads and mix
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Agencourt AMPure XP beads to each sample on the magnetic module in slot 1 and mix thoroughly to homogenize.

steps.title: Incubate bead‑bound DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑containing samples at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module for separation
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and allow it to run for 5 minutes to collect the beads.

steps.title: Perform two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 80 % freshly prepared ethanol as described below.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove any remaining 80 % ethanol from each sample after the two washes.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the bead pellet for 3 minutes with the magnetic module still engaged.

steps.title: Disengage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module before the next reagent addition.

steps.title: Add IDTE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 22 µL of IDTE buffer (pH 8.0) to each sample.

steps.title: Incubate with IDTE
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module for elution
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module and run for 3 minutes to separate the beads from the eluate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the supernatant (eluate) to the elution plate located in slot 5.

steps.title: Signal protocol completion
steps.instruction: The robot flashes its lights on and off to indicate that the protocol has finished.
